Dentistry

Academisch Centrum Tandheelkunde Amsterdam (ACTA) -- Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam and Universiteit van Amsterdam

← Back to search
About this programme

UCR currently cannot construct a sufficiently close programme for a meaningful curriculum comparison.

ACTA Dentistry combines oral biology and disease, restorative and preventive dentistry, scientific research and sustained dental skills training. Students progress from preclinical work to supervised patient treatment, care planning and work with medically complex patients. ACTA is the joint dental faculty of VU Amsterdam and the University of Amsterdam.

UCR offers useful biomedical science, laboratory methods, public health and health psychology. These courses do not provide the sustained dental knowledge, oral diagnosis, restoration techniques and patient-treatment progression that define this degree. We therefore show the verified ACTA curriculum without presenting a UCR programme as a comparable alternative.

Academic year: 2026–2027

All 180 EC are compulsory; the standard curriculum has no open minor or elective space. The 14-EC research placement includes a thesis and oral defence and requires the first-year methods course and second-year research preparation. Dutch language testing is an integrated introduction-course requirement. Dental prerequisites, at least 90% practical attendance and professional-conduct requirements apply. Positive first-year study advice requires 42 EC.
